Looking further into streamlining our build flags for different arches, I stumbled upon this comment:

https://github.com/RenderKit/embree/blob/ffc56d50a319c5eb3f246b3c8623f054514b06e6/tutorials/common/image/stb_image.h#L706-L719

I found notably that Fedora uses these flags for its `i686` (+SSE2) target:
```
$ grep march=i686 /usr/lib/rpm/redhat/rpmrc 
optflags: i686 %{__global_compiler_flags} -m32 -march=i686 -mtune=generic -msse2 -mfpmath=sse -mstackrealign -fasynchronous-unwind-tables -fstack-clash-protection
```

Maybe ensuring that Jolt (well here the whole of Godot) is compiled with `-msse2 -mfpmath=sse -mstackrealign` would solve the issue?
I'll test and likely add `-mstackrealign` to #105697. (I'm also preparing a follow-up PR adding `-march`/`-mtune` flags for all supported arches but that shouldn't be strictly needed to solve this I believe.)

I have retested it again, and did not get any crashes, same build, tho only difference is Nvidia driver was updated. So I assume this might be memory corruption caused by the driver bug that was the reason for both.
